title: Clarify health identification's independence from civil ID in 1.2.1
requirements:
- State that a health identifier and essential care must not require civil ID
- Link Box 1.2 coverage gaps to the equity principle on language access
- Describe the Client Registry as person-identity resolution and cross-referencing working with other trust capabilities
- State in 1.2.1/Box 1.2 that a single central health ID is not mandated
- Mention mechanisms for unidentified persons and newborns before registration
